quranTranslation.text: Every soul must taste of death, and We try you with evil and with good, for ordeal. And unto Us ye will be returned.

explanation.bs: „I iskušavamo vas zlom i dobrom, kao kušnjom“ – zlo i dobro kao par.
explanation.en: “We try you with evil and with good, for ordeal” — evil and good as a pair.

quranTranslation.text: And whoso doeth ill an atom's weight will see it then.

explanation.bs: „A ko učini zla teškog koliko trun, vidjet će ga“ – zlo kao djelo.
explanation.en: “And whoso doeth ill an atom's weight will see it then” — evil as a deed.

quranTranslation.text: From the evil of that which He created;

explanation.bs: „Od zla onoga što je On stvorio“ – zlo od kojeg se traži utočište.
explanation.en: “From the evil of that which He created” — evil from which refuge is sought.

quranTranslation.text: So they returned with grace and favour from Allah, and no harm touched them. They followed the good pleasure of Allah, and Allah is of Infinite Bounty.

explanation.bs: „I vratili su se s blagodati od Allaha i dobrotom, a nikakva ih nevolja (سُوء) nije dotakla“ – سُوء kao ono što čovjeka ožalosti, ovdje šteta koja ih nije zadesila.
explanation.en: “So they returned with grace and favour from Allah, and no harm (سُوء) touched them” — سُوء as what grieves a person, here harm that did not reach them.

gloss.en: ill, what grieves; a foul deed

quranTranslation.text: It will not be in accordance with your desires, nor the desires of the People of the Scripture. He who doeth wrong will have the recompense thereof, and will not find against Allah any protecting friend or helper.

explanation.bs: „Ko učini ružno djelo, bit će mu za njega uzvraćeno“ – ar-Rāġib: سُوء kao ružno djelo.
explanation.en: “He who doeth wrong will have the recompense thereof” — ar-Rāġib: سُوء as a foul deed.

gloss.en: ill, what grieves; a foul deed

quranTranslation.text: And thrust thy hand within thine armpit, it will come forth white without hurt. (That will be) another token.

explanation.bs: „Izaći će bijela, bez ikakve bolesti“ (bez سُوء) – ar-Rāġib: bez ikakve mane; tumači se kao guba.
explanation.en: “It will come forth white without hurt” (without سُوء) — ar-Rāġib: without any blemish; explained as leprosy.

gloss.en: ill, what grieves; a foul deed

quranTranslation.text: O my people! This is the camel of Allah, a token unto you, so suffer her to feed in Allah's earth, and touch her not with harm lest a near torment seize you.

explanation.bs: „Narode moj, ova Allahova kamila vama je znak, pa je pustite da jede po Allahovoj zemlji.“
explanation.en: “O my people! This is the camel of Allah, a token unto you, so suffer her to feed in Allah's earth.”

quranTranslation.text: He said: (Behold) this she-camel. She hath the right to drink (at the well), and ye have the right to drink, (each) on an appointed day.

explanation.bs: „Ovo je kamila; ona ima svoje pojenje, a vi svoje, u određeni dan.“
explanation.en: “(Behold) this she-camel. She hath the right to drink (at the well), and ye have the right to drink, (each) on an appointed day.”

quranTranslation.text: So they hamstrung the she-camel, and they flouted the commandment of their Lord, and they said: O Salih! Bring upon us that thou threatenest if thou art indeed of those sent (from Allah).

explanation.bs: „Pa su osakatili (ʿaqarū) kamilu i oholo se usprotivili naredbi Gospodara svoga.“
explanation.en: “So they hamstrung (ʿaqarū) the she-camel, and they flouted the commandment of their Lord.”

quranTranslation.text: Lo! they who deny Our revelations and scorn them, for them the gates of heaven will nor be opened not will they enter the Garden until the camel goeth through the needle's eye. Thus do We requite the guilty.

explanation.bs: „… niti će u Džennet ući sve dok deva kroz ušicu igle ne prođe“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: They will not enter the Garden “until the camel goeth through the needle's eye” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Will they not regard the camels, how they are created?

explanation.bs: „Zar ne gledaju u deve, kako su stvorene?“ – ar-Rāġib bilježi i mišljenje da su to oblaci, a to bi, ako je tačno, kaže, bilo poređenje oblaka s devama.
explanation.en: “Will they not regard the camels, how they are created?” — ar-Rāġib also records a view that clouds are meant, which, if correct, he says would be by likening clouds to camels.

quranTranslation.text: And of the camels twain and of the oxen twain. Say: Hath He forbidden the two males or the two females, or that which the wombs of the two females contain; or were ye by to witness when Allah commanded you (all) this? Then who doth greater wrong than he who deviseth a lie concerning Allah, that he may lead mankind astray without knowledge. Lo! Allah guideth not wrongdoing folk.

explanation.bs: „Te dvoje od deva, i dvoje od goveda“ – deve kao vrsta stoke; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And of the camels twain and of the oxen twain” — camels as a kind of livestock; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: They said: We have lost the king's cup, and he who bringeth it shall have a camel-load, and I (said Joseph) am answerable for it.

explanation.bs: „… a ko ga donese – njemu tovar deve“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “… he who bringeth it shall have a camel-load” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And when they opened their belongings they discovered that their merchandise had been returned to them. They said: O our father! What (more) can we ask? Here is our merchandise returned to us. We shall get provision for our folk and guard our brother, and we shall have the extra measure of a camel (load). This (that we bring now) is a light measure.

explanation.bs: „… i dobit ćemo još jednu devinu mjeru.“
explanation.en: “… and we shall have the extra measure of a camel (load).”

quranTranslation.text: Warfare is ordained for you, though it is hateful unto you; but it may happen that ye hate a thing which is good for you, and it may happen that ye love a thing which is bad for you. Allah knoweth, ye know not.

explanation.bs: „Propisana vam je borba, iako vam je mrska. A može biti da vam je mrsko nešto, a ono je dobro za vas“ – mrsko po naravi, kaže ar-Rāġib; on navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Warfare is ordained for you, though it is hateful unto you; but it may happen that ye hate a thing which is good for you” — hateful by nature, ar-Rāġib says; he cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Shun much suspicion; for lo! some suspicion is a crime. And spy not, neither backbite one another. Would one of you love to eat the flesh of his dead brother? Ye abhor that (so abhor the other)! And keep your duty (to Allah). Lo! Allah is Relenting, Merciful.

explanation.bs: „Zar bi ijedan od vas volio da jede meso mrtvog brata svoga? Pa vama je to mrsko!“ – ar-Rāġib: duša je stvorena da se od toga gnuša.
explanation.en: “Would one of you love to eat the flesh of his dead brother? Ye abhor that” — ar-Rāġib: the soul is made to loathe it.

quranTranslation.text: That is because they are averse to that which Allah hath revealed, therefor maketh He their actions fruitless.

explanation.bs: „To je stoga što im je mrsko ono što je Allah objavio, pa je On njihova djela poništio.“
explanation.en: “That is because they are averse to that which Allah hath revealed, therefor maketh He their actions fruitless.”

quranTranslation.text: Fain would they put out the light of Allah with their mouths, but Allah disdaineth (aught) save that He shall perfect His light, however much the disbelievers are averse.

explanation.bs: „Hoće da Allahovo svjetlo ustima svojim ugase, a Allah odbija sve drugo osim da Svoje svjetlo upotpuni, makar to nevjernicima bilo mrsko“ – obje riječi u istom ajetu; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Fain would they put out the light of Allah with their mouths, but Allah disdaineth [yaʾbā: refuseth] (aught) save that He shall perfect His light, however much the disbelievers are averse” — both words in one ayah; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And verily We have displayed for mankind in this Qur'an all kind of similitudes, but most of mankind refuse aught save disbelief.

explanation.bs: „Mi smo, zaista, ljudima u ovom Kur'anu na razne načine iznijeli svakojake primjere, ali većina ljudi odbi sve osim nevjerovanja.“
explanation.en: “And verily We have displayed for mankind in this Qur'an all kind of similitudes, but most of mankind refuse aught save disbelief.”

quranTranslation.text: So they twain journeyed on till, when they came unto the folk of a certain township, they asked its folk for food, but they refused to make them guests. And they found therein a wall upon the point of falling into ruin, and he repaired it. (Moses) said: If thou hadst wished, thou couldst have taken payment for it.

explanation.bs: „… zamoliše njene stanovnike da ih nahrane, ali su ovi odbili da im budu domaćini“ – Musa i njegov pratilac.
explanation.en: “… they asked its folk for food, but they refused to make them guests” — Moses and his companion.

quranTranslation.text: When the heaven is split asunder

explanation.bs: „Kad se nebo raspukne“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “When the heaven is split asunder” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: The hour drew nigh and the moon was rent in twain.

explanation.bs: „Približio se Čas i Mjesec se raspuknuo.“ – većina mufessira: znak u Poslanikovo vrijeme; ar-Rāġib navodi i druga mišljenja.
explanation.en: “The hour drew nigh and the moon was rent in twain.” — most mufassirun: a sign in the Prophet's time; ar-Rāġib also reports other views.

quranTranslation.text: When the heaven is cleft asunder,

explanation.bs: „Kad se nebo rasiječe“ – rascjep; ar-Rāġib kao osnovno značenje korijena daje cijepanje po dužini.
explanation.en: “When the heaven is cleft asunder” — a cleaving; ar-Rāġib gives the root sense as splitting along the length.

quranTranslation.text: Then We inspired Moses, saying: Smite the sea with thy staff. And it parted, and each part was as a mountain vast.

explanation.bs: „… Udari more svojim štapom! I ono se razdvojilo, a svaki dio bio je poput ogromnog brda.“ – dijelovi stoje odvojeni; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Smite the sea with thy staff. And it parted, and each part was as a mountain vast.” — the parts stand apart; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.
